title: Slide Into It
intro: Slide is the 303's signature: a slid note keeps its gate open and bends into the next note instead of starting it again. Switch on the slide under a note that has another note right after it — a tie mark joins the two — and do it at least twice. A slide into an empty step only holds the note longer, so it does not count here. Moving between two different pitches makes the bend easy to hear.
